text.zh: 皮质在外面，负责想。可"怕不怕""记不记得住""动不动得起来"这几件事，主事的都不在表面，得切进去才看得见。
text.en: The cortex sits on the outside and does the thinking. But being afraid, remembering, and getting moving at all are decided deeper in — you have to cut inside to see who is in charge.

text.zh: 先看这几团。皮质想做的动作太多，得有人挑一个放行、把其余按住。多巴胺变少时，放行这一步就卡住了。
text.en: These masses come first. The cortex proposes far more movements than you need; something has to wave one through and hold the rest down. When dopamine runs short, the waving-through is what jams.

text.zh: 再往前下一点，藏着一对杏仁大的核团。它的活是给每一个感觉贴标签：这件事危险吗？贴完再交给皮质细看。
text.en: A little further down and forward hides a pair of almond-sized nuclei. Their job is to label every incoming sensation — is this dangerous? — and only then pass it up for a proper look.

text.zh: 紧挨着它的是一对弯钩。刚才那一秒发生的事，要变成明年还想得起来的事，必须先在这里过一道。
text.en: Right beside them lies a pair of curved hooks. For the last second of your life to become something you can still call up next year, it has to pass through here first.

text.zh: 从弯钩伸出来一束白色的缆绳，拱过脑室往前走。记忆不是存在一个点上，是沿着这条环路跑起来的。
text.en: A white cable runs out of those hooks, vaulting forward over the ventricles. Memory is not filed at a point; it circulates around a loop, and this is the loop’s main line.

text.zh: 这些结构都泡在液体里。液体的产地就在脑室里——垂着的这几丛毛茸茸的东西，一天能造出换三四遍的量。
text.en: All of this floats in fluid, and the fluid is made right here in the ventricles by these dangling fringes — enough in a day to replace the whole volume three or four times over.

text.zh: 最后是这颗米粒。天黑了它就往血里放褪黑素，天亮了停——脑子里那只跟着日光走的表，走的是它的时。
text.en: Last, this grain of a gland. When it goes dark it releases melatonin into the blood, and when it gets light it stops — the clock in your head that follows the sun keeps its time.

text.zh: 所以"我"并不全在皮质上。害怕、想得起来、迈得出腿，这几件事分别归几团藏在中间的灰质管。
text.en: So "you" are not all up on the cortex. Being afraid, being able to recall, being able to take a step — each belongs to a different clump of grey buried in the middle.
